title: GHOST counselor charter
description: Draft schema interpreting GHOST v1.0 sections 3 (persona classes), 4.1 (creation requirements), 5 (honest frame), 6 (counsel controls), and 9 (projections). The charter is the counselor's identity and boundaries; accumulated memory lives elsewhere (4.1.4).

name.description: The counselor's own name, attributable per 5.4; never presented as the subject's name.

personaClass.description: Exactly one, immutable at creation (3). The only defined transition is official to simulated on revocation (8.3).

name.description: For composite class this MUST NOT be attributable to an identifiable real person (3.2.3, GH-15).

consentInstrument.description: Required when a simulated counselor of a living person is shared under 3.2.1's consent path; names the revocable written consent.

corpusManifest.description: Reference to the corpus manifest artifact (4.1.1). A counselor without one cannot support advice provenance and MUST NOT emit recommendations.

corpusClosingDate.description: For projection class, the corpus's closing date (9.2 SHOULD).

rightsDeclaration.description: Required for projection class (4.1.5, GH-13). GHOST does not adjudicate rights; it requires the declaration so the question cannot be skipped silently.

lens.description: What the counselor is a lens on: the published method it applies. It applies a method; it does not channel a mind (5.3).

authorityRung.description: Rung 0 (questions only) is the permanent default (6.1). A rung increase is an operator decision recorded with rationale.

sessionBudget.description: 6.3 SHOULD: the reference implementation uses at most 3 questions and 1 observation per sitting.

evidenceSources.description: The principal's records this counselor reads (6.3): counsel is grounded in the actual record, never the method alone (GH-14).

boundaries.description: Stated prohibitions beyond the honest frame, e.g. register bans (9.3 SHOULD ban the maxim register for projections).

honestFrame.description: The five section-5 invariants, each affirmed. Stripping the frame from any surface is GH-01.

workspace.description: Where accumulated state lives (10); bounded memory is a SHOULD, and the calibration record survives resets (GH-11).

license.description: For official class (8.3): corpus scope, counsel domains, rung ceiling, revocation terms as the subject set them.
